description: The human acts and the one message that hands each to the person. The command is built and checked by gtt-handoff.sh, never typed by a model. An agent hands over an act with `gtt-handoff.sh <act> [arguments]` and shows its output, nothing more. Acts that have a `gtt` command use it when the CLI is installed and their `script` otherwise.
